title: Chic East Nashville Stay | Walkable & Peaceful
description:
Experience modern comfort and vintage charm in East Nashville, just 10 mins from downtown. This 2-bedroom retreat features a king & queen bed, stylish design, private office, and a tranquil fully fenced backyard with a spacious porch. Walk to top restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and a 20-acre park. The perfect blend of city energy and neighborhood calm.

The space
Located within a 10-15 minute walking radius from the house you can find dozens of great restaurants, bars, coffee shops and more. Some trendy and local favorites to check out are:

-Dose Coffee
-Sho's Pizza
-The Village Pub
-Babu Korean Bar
-Cafe Roze
-Schulman's
-Hattie Jane's Creamery
-Vinyl Tap
-Golden Prawn #3

We love furry friends and the backyard is fully fenced. If traveling with pets please make sure you account for them in your booking. There is a mandatory pet fee to cover additional cleaning required.

Guest access
Our property is a freestanding house and guests will have access to all amenities. The backyard is fully fenced.

Other things to note
We are happy to provide a generous amount of supplies as a "start-pack" to your stay. We are not obligated to refill supplies during your stay of 30 or more days. Thank you for understanding!
